textRun.content: Make a copy of this document (File → Make a copy). Then replace the sample text. The header and footer repeat on every page, so you do not need to edit them.
Use the paragraph styles in the style menu. Do not change fonts or colours by hand. The styles already carry the V4AIR brand.
The document name, once, on page one
Date, version or a one-line summary under the title
is the colour for text. Rust
marks small labels and links. Grey
is for secondary text. Do not add other colours.
Use bullets for items in no particular order:
No full stop after a fragment.
Full stop after a full sentence.
Make a copy of this template.
Write the content in the paragraph styles.
Share the copy, not this template.
Use a quote block for one key point that readers must not miss. Keep it to two or three sentences.
Write links as words, for example
. Do not paste bare addresses into running text.
